definitions.gloss: dominant hand; stronger hand; writing hand
definitions.explanation: The hand a person naturally prefers to use for tasks like writing, eating, and throwing.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{手|て}はどちらですか。
{私|わたし}の{利|き}き{手|て}は{左|ひだり}です。
examples.english: My dominant hand is my left hand.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{手|て}を{怪我|けが}したので、{反対|はんたい}の{手|て}で{箸|はし}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I injured my dominant hand, so I'm using chopsticks with my other hand.

notes: The {利|き}き prefix means "dominant" or "preferred" and is also used in {利|き}き{足|あし} (dominant foot) and {利|き}き{目|め} (dominant eye). Usually written in mixed kana/kanji as {利|き}き{手|て} rather than all kanji. In Japan, being left-handed ({左利|ひだりき}き) was traditionally corrected, though this practice has become less common.
